tests.requirement: Every ranking row's prevented_claim_ids equals the descendant claim set of its intervention node.
tests.evidence: all ranked prevented_claim_ids match descendant claim sets

tests.requirement: Permuting node/edge input order must not change the ranked intervention_id sequence (deterministic sort key).
tests.evidence: identity after shuffle: True; tie-break is (-score_micro, phase_index, cost_seconds, intervention_id)

tests.requirement: available_at_phase index <= min descendant finding phase; anachronisms are rejected not ranked.
cost_basis=ESTIMATE requires estimate_band in {XS,S,M,L,XL}; DERIVED costs come from timeout_seconds.

reviewer.notes: Named probe1 re-derives descendant claim sets from the embedded hierarchy. Named probe2 permutes a planted DAG and plants a phase-anachronism plus an ESTIMATE-without-band mutant. The two probes do not share a verdict file.

evidence.note: CC-* and SYN-* dependency edges used when SYN-0001 is absent.
Draft-07 schema rejects garbage objects lacking ranking rows with prevented_claim_ids.

formula: Cheapest earlier action per cause is the candidate CAUSE/MECHANISM node whose descendants form the prevented claim set; ranking is subtree_size x max(severity_weight) / cost_seconds with a frozen lexicographic tie-break.
